Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/prose.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Prose`

```ts
Prose(props: ProseProps): Html
```

Typography for flowing content the kit did not build — the HTML a
Markdown renderer or a CMS hands back: headings, paragraphs, lists,
quotes, code, tables, images, rules. Everything under `.prose` is
styled by element, so the content needs no classes of its own.

### `proseHtml`

```ts
proseHtml(trusted: string): Html
```

Wraps an HTML string the server has ALREADY SANITISED as `Html`, so it
can be the `content` of `Prose`. THIS IS THE ONE PLACE A STRING BYPASSES
ESCAPING: pass it ONLY markup your own renderer produced from a trusted
source or ran through an allow-list sanitiser — NEVER user input, a
request body, or anything a browser sent you. If in doubt, escape it
normally with `html` instead.

## Types

### `ProseSize`

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `ProseProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `content` | `Html` | yes | Rendered content — a document body, a Markdown preview, help text. |
| `size` | `ProseSize` |  |  |
| `measure` | `boolean` |  | Cap the line length at `--layout-measure` (70ch). |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes on the wrapper; a `class` merges. |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A help article the server rendered from Markdown

`proseHtml` wraps HTML your renderer already sanitised — never a user's raw input. The result is the editor preview's natural home.

```ts
Prose({
  measure: true,
  content: proseHtml("<h2>Refunds</h2><p>A refund reaches the card within <strong>5 days</strong>.</p>"),
})
```

```html
<div class="prose prose--measure">
  <h2>Refunds</h2>
  <p>
    A refund reaches the card within
    <strong>5 days</strong>
    .
  </p>
</div>
```

### Content built with the template

```ts
Prose({
  size: "sm",
  content: html`
    <p>Escaped like any other markup: ${"<b>not bold</b>"}</p>
  `,
})
```

```html
<div class="prose prose--sm">
  <p>Escaped like any other markup: &lt;b&gt;not bold&lt;/b&gt;</p>
</div>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/prose/prose.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.prose`, `.prose--lg`, `.prose--measure`, `.prose--sm`
